title: Seasoning Credit on Deferral Fees for Older Contracts
content:
**Term.** A deferral on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts earns a seasoning credit, a flat dollar credit subtracted from the deferral fee, that follows the age of the contract in whole months from the contract date to the request date: at least 24 whole months take the long-seasoning deferral credit of 2.00; 12 to 23 whole months take the mid-seasoning deferral credit of 1.00; a younger contract takes none.

| Contract age on the request date | Seasoning credit |
|---|---|
| 24 whole months or more | 2.00 |
| 12 to 23 whole months | 1.00 |
| under 12 whole months | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, contract date 2024-07-31)

| Request date | Whole months | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-31 | 24 | 2.00 |
| 2026-07-30 | 23 | 1.00 |
| 2025-07-31 | 12 | 1.00 |
| 2025-07-30 | 11 | none |
